name: Saudi Research and Media Group (SRMG)
verdict: A listed Saudi media group whose controlling ownership runs through state-linked funds to Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund.
note: DS Penske partner in the joint 'NEOM-SRMG' block on the team site; the club's Season 12 partners press kit (Dec 2025) names the partner as SRMG. Rating note: on hold for a maintainer; the pull request proposes serious. The link is srmg-state-ownership (State Media Monitor + TheWrap); control is indirect (PIF is the ultimate controlling party of SNB, whose Al Ahli Capital funds hold the controlling stake). The record is saudi-executions-2025 (HRW + Amnesty).

why.text: Saudi Research and Media Group is a listed Saudi media company whose controlling ownership runs through state-linked funds to Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund. Saudi Arabia executed at least 356 people in 2025, a record. The state sits behind the SRMG logo on DS Penske's Formula E entry. That's called sportswashing.
